summary: Completed frontend-only testing of Crystal Prism UI redesign for Tubiate (YouTube Affiliate Prospect Finder). All pages and features tested successfully - Landing, Pricing, Login, Signup, Dashboard, Terms, Privacy pages all render correctly with the new Crystal Prism theme. Login flow with admin@tubiate.com/admin123! works correctly. Dashboard header shows all expected elements (API Key badge, History button, Settings button, Bug report button, user email, logout). Dialogs open/close properly. Logout redirects to home and protects dashboard.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Crystal Prism UI redesign tested successfully. All pages render with correct styling - glassmorphism headers (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl), gradient buttons (indigo-to-purple), rounded-full pill shapes, proper font hierarchy (Outfit for headings, Manrope for body). Dashboard shows glass-card styling with proper shadows and hover effects. Auth flow works with admin@tubiate.com / admin123!. YouTube search functionality not tested (API quota concerns) but UI elements verified.
